prompts.terminal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background image for the live agent floor in a web app. Generate one wide landscape image, approximately 3:2. High quality crisp pixel-art game room environment, overhead three-quarter camera facing the back wall, symmetrical rectangular room filling the entire canvas, consistent parallel room edges rather than isometric diamond. The top 22% is a back wall with windows and architectural detail; bottom 75% is mostly clear open floor where separate desk-and-person sprites will be overlaid. Modest decoration only at extreme edges. No people, no desks, no chairs, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Avoid large foreground objects. Clearly an interior room with a continuous floor, not a landscape wallpaper. Terminal theme: a retro computing lab at night, charcoal and blue-gray steel wall panels, muted slate floor tiles, subtle mint green instrument lights and tiny server cabinets along the far back corners, back windows overlooking a midnight city. Restrained green highlights, calm dark floor that still shows tile detail, atmospheric but highly legible.
